summary: The rename leaves no compatibility residue and nothing here duplicates the existing law-level prefix API, but the file exposes only the ℝ≥0∞ set-integral corollary of a strictly more useful primitive — that the reindexing preserves `ρ.restrict A` — which is two lines away and is the form the stated Layer 5 (Koopman/Lᵖ) consumer actually needs.
